attrs.note: GPT-5.6's caveat on channel completeness, and it is the one channel a closed world cannot close from the inside. `model: foo-27b` is not a support identity. Three exits: a local content-addressed model, a provider-signed immutable deployment revision, or this assumption carried undischarged. Recording it is what keeps the third option honest — an unrecorded remote model is invisible influence, which is exactly what SUPPORT-CHANNEL-COMPLETE forbids.
attrs.statement: A remote model named by string identifier denotes one fixed artifact: the provider has not changed weights, routing, quantization, system-side prompts, safety layers or runtime behind that name.
